Looking at this incident report:

- Production system: Yes (production site)
- User impact: All users affected: Yes
- Workaround available: No

This matches the P1 criteria exactly: production system, all users affected, and no workaround.

Label: P1

Looking at this incident report, I need to evaluate each criterion:

- Production system: Yes, this is a production site
- All users affected: No, only users on the legacy plan are affected (roughly 10%)
- No workaround: Yes, there is no workaround

Since only some users are affected (10% of legacy plan users) and there's no workaround, this meets the criteria for P2 priority.

Label: P2

Looking at this incident report, I need to evaluate each rule:

Rule P1: production system, all users affected, and no workaround
- This is a staging environment, not production
- The report states "staging site" which is non-production

Rule P2: production system, only some users affected, and no workaround
- This is not a production system
- The report says "Every user is affected" but this is still not a production system

Rule P3: anything else (a non-production system, or a workaround exists)
- This is a staging environment (non-production)
- There is no workaround
- The issue affects all users on the staging site

Since this is a non-production system (staging), even though it affects all users, it doesn't meet the criteria for P1 or P2 because it's not in production.

Label: P3
